description.zh: 应用镜像ID，可从无影云应用控制台的镜像管理页面获取。
description.en: The application image ID. You can obtain this value from the Image Management page in the WUYING Cloud Application console.

description.zh: 交付组名称，查询时采用模糊匹配规则。例如，假设填写的交付组名称为`办公应用`，则名称中包含`办公应用`的交付组都会被查询到，例如名为`我的办公应用`、`办公应用A`的交付组。
description.en: The delivery group name. Fuzzy match is used for the query. For example, if you set the delivery group name to `Office App`, all delivery groups whose names contain `Office App` are returned, such as `My Office App` and `Office App A`.

description.zh: 交付组所属的地域ID。关于支持的地域详情，请参见[使用限制](~~426036~~)。
description.en: The region ID of the delivery group. For more information about supported regions, see [Limits](~~426036~~).

description.zh: 购买资源的规格类型ID。可通过[ListNodeInstanceType](~~ListNodeInstanceType~~)接口获取。
description.en: The specification type ID of the purchased resources. You can call the [ListNodeInstanceType](~~ListNodeInstanceType~~) operation to obtain this value.

description.zh: 需展示的查询结果页码。
description.en: The page number of the query results to display.

description.zh: 每页的查询结果数量，不可超过`100`。
description.en: The number of query results per page. Maximum value: `100`.
The list of delivery group statuses.

title.zh: 查询多个交付组详细信息
